svg.title: A Placement Funnel with Traceable Denominators
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-authorized-placement-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: A Placement Funnel with Traceable Denominators; subtitle: One 100-request cohort narrows to twelve executed, funded starts.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative acquisition cohort, not observed conversion data or an annual revenue forecast. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage; use one request identifier throughout.; caption: Track loss reasons separately: missing authority, inventory mismatch, rejected terms, or an unfunded start.; stages: label: Received housing requests; value: 100 requests captured within one intake cohort; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Deduplicate requests across adjusters, relocation desks, and authorized housing portals. Count one household or corporate assignment once, even when multiple properties are proposed.; label: Payer-qualified requests; value: 60 requests retain documented authority and budget; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Sixty percent of intake passes payer identity, approved dates, and budget checks. Reject unsupported promises that a later claim decision will reimburse the stay.; label: Inventory-matched requests; value: 36 qualified requests match permitted ready inventory; numeric value: 36.0; detail: Sixty percent of qualified requests fit landlord permission, location, household needs, readiness date, and occupancy limits; apply consistent screening and reasonable-accommodation procedures where required.; label: Accepted commercial terms; value: 18 matched requests accept documented pricing and terms; numeric value: 18.0; detail: Half of matched requests accept the complete quote, including taxes, utility caps, cancellation exposure, extension mechanics, and the responsible contracting payer.; label: Executed funded starts; value: 12 accepted requests become executed funded placements; numeric value: 12.0; detail: Two-thirds of accepted requests produce signed agreements and the required deposit or documented credit terms. Overall cohort conversion is twelve percent; placement count alone does not establish annual billings.

text.title: A Placement Funnel with Traceable Denominators
text.tspan: A Placement Funnel with Traceable Denominators

circle.title: label: Received housing requests; value: 100 requests captured within one intake cohort; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Deduplicate requests across adjusters, relocation desks, and authorized housing portals. Count one household or corporate assignment once, even when multiple properties are proposed.

label: Payer-qualified requests; value: 60 requests retain documented authority and budget; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Sixty percent of intake passes payer identity, approved dates, and budget checks. Reject unsupported promises that a later claim decision will reimburse the stay.

label: Inventory-matched requests; value: 36 qualified requests match permitted ready inventory; numeric value: 36.0; detail: Sixty percent of qualified requests fit landlord permission, location, household needs, readiness date, and occupancy limits; apply consistent screening and reasonable-accommodation procedures where required.

label: Accepted commercial terms; value: 18 matched requests accept documented pricing and terms; numeric value: 18.0; detail: Half of matched requests accept the complete quote, including taxes, utility caps, cancellation exposure, extension mechanics, and the responsible contracting payer.

label: Executed funded starts; value: 12 accepted requests become executed funded placements; numeric value: 12.0; detail: Two-thirds of accepted requests produce signed agreements and the required deposit or documented credit terms. Overall cohort conversion is twelve percent; placement count alone does not establish annual billings.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative acquisition cohort, not observed conversion data or an annual revenue forecast. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage; use one request identifier throughout.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Illustrative acquisition cohort, not observed conversion data or an annual revenue forecast. Each stage is a subset of
the preceding stage; use one request identifier throughout.
